name: Security Instrument Description 2
definition: Identifies the security instrument by its name and typical characteristics.

ClassificationType.name: Classification Type
ClassificationType.definition: Classification type of the financial instrument, as per the ISO Classification of Financial Instrument (CFI) codification, eg, common share with voting rights, fully paid, or registered.

PlaceOfListing.name: Place Of Listing
PlaceOfListing.definition: Provides the place of listing using a market identifier code (MIC).

ExerciseDate.name: Exercise Date
ExerciseDate.definition: Exercise date/time of a derivative contract.

MaturityDate.name: Maturity Date
MaturityDate.definition: Maturity date/time at which an interest bearing security becomes due.

OptionType.name: Option Type
OptionType.definition: Specifies whether it is a call option (right to purchase a specific underlying asset) or a put option (right to sell a specific underlying asset).

StrikePrice.name: Strike Price
StrikePrice.definition: Predetermined price at which the holder will have to buy or sell the underlying instrument.

Multiplier.name: Multiplier
Multiplier.definition: Indicates the ratio or multiplying factor used to convert one contract into a quantity. In the case of an equity or a bond, the price multiplier is 1.

MultiplierRule.definition: Multiplier cannot be equal to zero.
